cases.purpose: Focused device parity with explicit setup validation, read-error and later-operand checks in canonical, default and shortcut formats.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; stdout of each read is shown verbatim (newlines as |). Loop devices are attached to per-side images under /tmp/rt (outside the compared tree), detached by the fixture, and checked by the harness for leftovers after each side. The dm device is removed by the fixture and by the harness cleanup.
